chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Any woman who applies perfume for someone other than her husband, no salat (prayer) from her will be accepted until she washes from her perfume as she washes from her janabah.

key_terms.جَنَابَتِهَا: her state of janabah, major ritual impurity
key_terms.صَلَاةٌ: salat (prayer), whose acceptance is being discussed

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about a woman wearing perfume for someone other than her husband?
ai.summary: This hadith warns against a woman adorning herself with perfume for someone other than her husband. It presents the act as spiritually serious, linking it to the acceptance of salat (prayer) and requiring thorough washing from the perfume.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Any woman who applies perfume for someone other than her husband, her prayer will not be accepted until she washes off the perfume as she would wash after a state of major ritual impurity (janabah)."
